parameters.name: Databases
parameters.description:
The array of database objects.
>A maximum of 10 databases and 10 database accounts are supported. You can leave the database accounts unspecified. If no accounts are specified, permissions are granted at the database level.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
> You can invoke the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: UserGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the user group to which you want to grant permissions.
